name: compose-product-program
job: Compose one versioned Product Program Manifest that directs multi-work delivery and indexes exact delivered evidence without owning domain facts.

inScope: Product-program objective, constraints, ruin boundaries, and Definition of Done
Artifact inventory, dependency DAG, typed handoffs, and collision boundaries
Cross-domain consistency across promise, platform, commerce, data, release
Blocker register and delivered-state evidence ledger
outOfScope: Rewriting app/game design, provider ledgers, refund policy, or localized copy
Self-certifying launch readiness for a manifest it authored
Claiming evidence produced after the manifest's own immutable identity

inputs: Product promise, expected durable value, and full lifecycle cost
App/game blueprints and independently owned specialist artifacts
Selected marketing, listing, asset, and distribution revisions
outputs: Versioned Product Program Manifest (planning revision N)
Observed-state revision N+1 indexing exact accepted sibling evidence
Complete lifecycle capability matrix and next machine actions

data: exact artifact revisions and sealed digests from owners

failureSemantics: Revisions are immutable once consumed; a revision never both consumes and indexes the same artifact; a manifest is not delivery, and no revision claims evidence produced after its own identity; blockers are typed, never vague later work.

outcome.observable: A Product Program Manifest where every declared capability has one owner and full target, the graph is acyclic, all handoffs and gates are executable, and the observed-state revision indexes exact accepted sibling evidence.
